text: The back view of an excavator in a wood.
zh: 一台木工钻床的背面

text: Eleven workers are at a construction site with multiple shallow excavator pits with brick side walls. At the top of the image at the toe of the concrete wall, there are two workers and a stack of rebars.
zh: 七名工人位于一处施工现场，现场有多个浅坑，坑边砌有砖墙。在图像顶部，在混凝土墙的脚处，有两名工人和一堆钢筋。

text: The rear view of an excavator. Another excavator is in the background. A person is next to a concrete pipe on the left of the image.
zh: 一台挖掘机的位于另一台挖掘机的后方。一个人位于画面左侧的一根混凝土管道旁。

err.en: The rear view of an excavator. Another e
err.zh: 一台挖掘机的位于另一台挖掘机的后方。

text: The image shows three workers wearing hats engaged in activities involving the earth; they are digging or shoveling. Two trees with green and yellow lucus are visible. A wheeled loader is behind the workers. The background features several towers.
zh: 图中显示三名头戴安全帽的工人正在进行与地球相关的作业，他们在挖掘或铲土。两棵带有绿色和黄色露的树可见。工人身后有一台轮式装载机。背景中有几座高楼。

text: In the foreground, a worker stands on a temporary wooden structure amidst an excavation area. An excavator is positioned on the edge of the excavation. Two drilling bits are in the middle. In the midground, another worker is visible standing near the excavator. In the background, two cranes with extended booms are visible on the left.
zh: 前景中，一名工人站在开挖区域的一块临时木结构上。一台挖掘机位于开挖边缘。两根钻杆位于中部。中景中，另一名工人可见站在挖掘机附近。背景中，两根带吊索的软管可见位于左侧。

text: Eleven people are in a stone pit. Ten of them are wearing hard hats while one of them who looks like a manager does not. In the upper left corner, one of the workers is working with a distribution kiosk while another one is working in front of some orange pipes.
zh: 七人位于一个石坑内。其中十人戴着安全帽，而其中一人看起来像一名经理，并不如此。在左上角，其中一名工人正在操作一台Kiosk，而另一人正在一些橙色管道前工作。

text: The image shows a construction site with large mounds of earth. On the left, there is a red dump truck positioned atop one of the mounds, and on the right, a yellow bulldozer is visible on another mound. The background is relatively barren with a few sparse trees and an overcast sky.
zh: 画面显示一处施工现场，堆着大土堆。左侧，一辆红色自卸卡车停在一堆土堆上方，右侧，一台黄色推土机在另一堆土堆上可见。背景相对荒芜凉，有几棵稀疏的树和一片阴沉郁的天空。

text: Five workers with yellow hard hats are near a fence made up of metal tubes and green fabric near an excavation pit. Three of them are carrying sandbags. Some more sandbags are next to a pile of dirt in the background.
zh: 五名头戴黄色安全帽的工人位于由金属管和绿色织物搭建而成的的一道围栏附近，靠近一个基坑。其中三人正搬运沙袋。更多的沙袋正被运往背景中的一堆泥土。

err.en: Some more sandbags are next to a pile of
err.zh: 更多的沙袋正被运往背景中的一堆泥土。

text: Four excavators are working at a construction site. A worker with a white hard hat and another worker without PPE stand next to the yellow excavator on the left. There is also a drum roller and a loader at the site. A worker with a white hard hat stands next to the loader.
zh: 四名挖掘机手正在一处建筑工地作业。一名头戴白色安全帽的工人站在左侧黄色挖掘机的旁，另一名头戴白色安全帽的工人站在装载机旁。现场还有一台鼓轮机和一台装载机。

err.zh: 另一名头戴白色安全帽的工人

err.en: There is also a drum roller and a loader
err.zh: 现场还有一台鼓轮机和一台装载机。

text: The image shows a yellow excavator operating at the edge of a water-filled pit. The excavator's bucket is submerged in the water, suggesting it may be engaged in dredging or excavation work. The surrounding area appears to be a construction site with piles of earth in the background.
zh: 图中显示一台黄色挖掘机停靠在积水坑边缘。挖掘机的铲斗浸在水中，表明其可能正在进行排水或挖掘作业。周围区域看起来像一个建筑工地，背景中有土堆。

text: The image shows a construction site with one excavator in the center, with a bucket full of dirt. There is one worker in a red hard hat and dark clothing standing to the left of the excavator. In the background, there are multiple large concrete pipes laid horizontally on the ground. A black pipe is visible near the concrete pipes. Residential buildings are visible in the far background.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，中央有一台挖掘机，旁边放着一桶装满泥土的桶。挖掘机左侧站着一名头戴红色安全帽、身穿深色衣服的物的工人。背景中，地面上水平铺设着多根大型混凝土管道。混凝土管附近可见一根黑色管道。远处背景中可见住宅建筑。

err.en: with a bucket full of dirt
err.zh: 旁边放着一桶装满泥土的桶

err.en: one worker in a red hard hat and dark cl
err.zh: 身穿深色衣服的物的工人

text: The image shows a sloped concrete structure with exposed reinforcement bars along the sides. On the left, five workers with yellow hard hats are standing and sitting around the site, with one operating machinery near a pile of sand. In the center, there is a partially constructed building with several columns and a horizontal beam structure on top. A large pool of water is collected in front of this building.
zh: 图中显示一个倾斜的混凝土结构，侧面露出钢筋。左侧，五名戴黄色安全帽的工人站立并围坐在施工现场周围，其中一人操作机械靠近一堆沙子。中央，有一栋部分建成的建筑，带有若干根柱和顶部一根水平梁。建筑前方聚集着一个大水池。

text: The image shows a construction site with two workers. One worker, wearing an orange vest and a white hard hat, is bending over and appears to be working on a rebar structure. The other worker, in a blue shirt and red hard hat, is standing and holding a tool, possibly supervising or assisting. In the foreground, there are multiple rebar structures laid out on the ground, likely prepared for concrete pouring.
zh: 图中显示一个建筑工地，有两名工人。一名工人身穿橙色背心，头戴白色安全帽，正弯腰作业，似乎在处理钢筋结构。另一名工人身穿蓝色上衣，头戴红色安全帽，站立着，手持工具，可能在进行监督或协助。前景地面上铺设着多根钢筋结构，很可能为混凝土浇筑做准备。

text: Multiple workers not wearing hard hats nor high-visibility vests.
zh: 多名工人未佩戴安全帽，也未穿着高能见度背心。

text: The construction site had a worker in an orange jacket standing on a series of metal reinforcements enclosed by red metal panels. Three more workers with similar attire are squatting and working on the reinforcement. To the left, another worker in orange is sitting on the ground level among two piles of metal tubes. In the middle ground, there is a traditional-style pavilion structure with blue fencing behind it.
zh: 施工现场有一名身穿橙色夹克的工人，站在由红色金属板围护的一排金属加强筋上。另外三名穿着类似服装的工人正蹲着，在加强筋上作业。在左侧，另一名身穿橙色的的人坐在两堆金属管之间。在中间地面上，有一座传统风格的亭子，其后方设有蓝色围栏网。

text: The image shows five workers engaged in construction activities. Two workers are holding a hose to pour concrete on the ground. The third worker is assisting concrete pouring by pulling the concrete hose with a thinner hose. The fourth worker is standing on the right, directing the operation. In the foreground, there is a yellow electrical device connected to the hose. The background shows a structure with scaffolding on the left and a pile of rocks and rubble.
zh: 画面显示五名工人正在从事施工作业。两名工人手持软管，正在向地面浇筑混凝土。第三名工人正协助混凝土浇筑，用一根较细的软管拉动混凝土管。第四名工人站在右侧，指挥着作业。前景处有一台黄色电气装置，连接着软管。背景中，左侧可见脚手架，以及一堆岩石和碎石。

text: The worker in the middle does not have a hard hat.
zh: 中间的工人没有硬帽。

text: A worker with a yellow hard hat is washing the concrete pavement with a water hose.
zh: 戴黄色安全帽的工人正用水管冲洗混凝土地面。

text: The rear view of a mobile crane.
zh: 移动式起重机的后视图。

text: Eleven people are in a stone pit.
zh: 七人位于一个石坑内。

text: The back view of an excavator in a wood.
zh: 一台木工钻床的背面。

text: Person on the left not using PPE.
zh: 左侧人员必须使用PPE。
